response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something is missing. This kingdom needs a new aesthetic.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I want to modernize our kingdom's style. Something sleek, something futuristic.

JESTER PIPER
But, Your Majesty, we are in the Middle Ages. We can't just... (he gestures to the surrounding landscape)...do that.

KING REGINALD
Nonsense, Piper! I have a vision. (he turns to a nearby scribe, Scribe THOMAS) Thomas, get me a sketch artist.

SCRIBE THOMAS
Yes, Your Majesty.

The scribe hurries off, leaving the king to ponder his vision.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The scribe returns with a sketch artist, ARTIST LUCAS. Lucas is a quirky, bespectacled man with a wild shock of hair.

ARTIST LUCAS
Your Majesty, I have a concept. (he holds up a sketch) Behold!

The king takes the sketch and examines it. It depicts a futuristic, neon-lit kingdom, with sleek, aerodynamic buildings and flying machines zipping through the air.

KING REGINALD
By the saints! This is it! This is the aesthetic I was thinking of!

ARTIST LUCAS
But, Your Majesty, won't this... (he gestures to the sketch)...confuse our subjects?

KING REGINALD
Confuse them? Ha! They need to be confused. They need to be disoriented. (he turns to Jester Piper) Piper, get the royal architects on this immediately.

JESTER PIPER
Yes, Your Majesty.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed overnight. Buildings are now sleek, futuristic structures, with neon lights and holographic advertisements. Knights ride flying machines, and peasants wear futuristic, high-tech clothing.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
It's working. The kingdom is embracing this new aesthetic.

But as the king looks out over his transformed kingdom, he notices something strange. The subjects are all staring at small, glowing rectangles in their hands. They're all... (he gasps)...using smartphones!

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
What sorcery is this?

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king summons his advisors, including Scribe Thomas and Artist Lucas.

KING REGINALD
I want to know more about these... (he gestures to the smartphones)... devices.

SCRIBE THOMAS
They're called smartphones, Your Majesty. They're... (he hesitates)... portable computers.

KING REGINALD
Portable computers? (he looks at Artist Lucas) Lucas, can you make one of these... (he gestures to the smartphones)... devices?

ARTIST LUCAS
I can try, Your Majesty.

Lucas sets to work, tinkering with the device. The king watches, fascinated.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
This is the future. This is the aesthetic I was thinking of.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a fully-fledged proto-vaporwave utopia. Knights ride flying machines, peasants wear futuristic clothing, and the king sits on his throne, surrounded by holographic advertisements.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
It's working. The kingdom is embracing this new aesthetic.

But as the king looks out over his kingdom, he notices something strange. The subjects are all staring at the king, their eyes glazed over in a mixture of confusion and fascination.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
I think I may have made a mistake.

FADE TO BLACK.
